relations.note: Augustin invents Wamba as Makandal’s wife.
Augustin invents Dominique as Makandal and Wamba’s son.

relations.myth: Makandal assumes Ayizan’s herbal and initiatory authority
relations.note: Depestre poetically overlays Makandal with Ayizan’s authority over initiation and medicinal herbs.

relations.myth: Mandate to destroy whites and return Blacks to Africa
relations.note: Later legend claims Petro spirits mandated Makandal’s anticolonial mission.

relations.myth: Makandal instructs Ti Noël before his execution
relations.note: Makandal instructs and inspires Ti Noël, who witnesses his career and execution.

relations.myth: Makandal mentors Agaté as an Assassin
relations.note: Agaté remembers Makandal as his Assassin mentor.
